scenario: RFCS.6 fact-assert atom over [RFCS.19.1] framing, with [RFCS.5.1] the up-front announcement: a fact's typed slot values encode into a FactAssert atom whose `fact` body is the schema's proto payload, its fields numbered by slot position ([LFST.8.10]), and every registered schema is announced right after the StreamHeader, before any event atom -- one SchemaDef and one Slot per slot, in declaration order: ComputationError and TypeError ([LERR.9.2], [LERR.9.3]; five slots each), TimeZoneOffset ([LTIM.10.6], [LIMP.12.2]; four slots), then Reading (sensor, val, ok): the artefact's order. So the schema's SchemaDef precedes the first FactAssert that uses it ([RFCS.6.5]). A multi-slot Reading fact goes through the stream: record, then decode. The assert takes the engine's first clock sample, which is recorded before its input ([LTIM.2.8.5]): ClockAdvance, then FactAssert; there is no pump, so no PumpBoundary. PATH PINNED: the stream each runtime's own recorder writes -- libds's `ds_rfcs_record_to` (rfcs/codec.c, recorder.c) through pyds `Engine.record` in runner.py, and the Mercury runtime's `ds.rfcs` writer in compiler/mercury/test/test_behave.m. The atom list names each atom by its body message, and is every atom the registry names, Slot included, in both harnesses.
